name: docusaurus
description_en: Easy to maintain open source documentation websites.
readme_excerpt: Docusaurus Introduction Docusaurus is a project for building, deploying, and maintaining open source project websites easily. Short on time? Check out our 5-minute tutorial ⏱️! Tip: use docusaurus.new to test Docusaurus immediately in a playground. - Simple to Start > Docusaurus is built in a way so that it can get running in as little time as possible. We've built Docusaurus to handle the website build process so you can focus on your project. - Localizable > Docusaurus ships with localization…
